b1.root_cause: postgres public-function default ACL grants service_role EXECUTE; nine original helper revokes omitted service_role

b2.root_cause: PostgreSQL non-superuser CREATEROLE automatic bootstrap-superuser ADMIN-only grant
b2.trust_boundary: postgres is a trusted migration/management administrator, not a worker/client role

regression.clock_test: test-only time source replacement; production clock has no override

local_supabase.worker_JWT: server-signed synthetic local role; never issued to client
